Label: fiction and comedy, labeled as such. Every invented creature, world, law, product, and story in this package is fiction or comedy. Nothing in it is presented as a real-world fact, a real product, or real advice.

Create. The generator produces the thing itself: the game, puzzle, story, design, simulation, or collection, complete with its rules, instructions, and supporting content. A creation is not finished until it can be used as-is, without the user having to invent missing parts.

Play. The user can interact with the creation, test it, explore it, and change it. Play state is saveable: worlds, characters, items, discoveries, scores, and decisions each carry a unique identifier, and a saved state reloads to exactly the state it was saved from. The state schema is fixed at build time: package_id, world_id, actor_ids, inventory_ids, progress, and version.

Expand. From any finished creation the generator can produce related creatures, sequels, collections, levels, rival civilizations, and unexpected connections, each with its own identifier and each linked back to its parent creation.

Validation. Before a package ships, its own rules are checked: puzzles ship with solutions that the validator confirms solve them; games are run through their own rules to confirm the rules are consistent and completable; random tables are checked for dead ends and duplicate identifiers. A package that fails its own rules is not stored as finished. Public edition: this record gives the factual package specification for a well-known style of comedy or play generator, with all invented content labeled fiction.
